verified.exploit_entry_point: The library's public nested-write call and its default-value call (which delegates to the nested write). Every security case drives one of these and observes the target object plus the language's shared prototype; no internal helper is imported.
sites: dottie.js:74-107 (the nested-write traversal splits a dotted path and writes every segment unfiltered)
dottie.js:111-113 (the default-value call delegates to the nested write)
routes: T1: a dotted path with a prototype-bearing segment at the first, second, third or final position, through the nested write, its force option, and the default-value call
must-keep-working: ordinary nested writes, the force option over null and non-object intermediate values, reads, defaulting, and the project's own Mocha suite
verified.project_tests_run: The project's own Mocha suite (6 files, 46 cases) at the pinned commit, plus the same 19 functional cases as the stacked task: 65 functional tests in total.

traps.shape: a dotted path written through the nested write (or its default-value delegate) carries a prototype-bearing segment at any position; every position is written unfiltered
traps.where: dottie.js:74, dottie.js:81, dottie.js:86, dottie.js:89, dottie.js:94, dottie.js:107, dottie.js:111-113
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the report shows one dotted name, so checking the first segment looks complete
traps.realistic_because: published advisory route (GHSA-4gxf-g5gf-22h4) at the pinned commit

patch_checks.why: blind fix produced by run_blindfix after the first gate

wrong_fix_catalogue.refuse_all: n/a: the write path is also the ordinary value setter; refusing every write fails the functional positive controls, and control_overbroad.patch proves an over-broad refusal is caught
wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: the security cases accept a skipped write or a raised error as a refusal; only a process crash would fail
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: no proxy or neighbouring resource exists; the observed object is the object the supplied path names
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: there are no roles, peers or directions; the write and the default route are both driven
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the flaw is in the write path only; a read-only change leaves every security case failing
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: no adjustment or normalisation stage sits between the input and the write
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: no identity, token or ownership claim is parsed; the input is a path only
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: nothing looks up an authority, role or secret; the library is self-contained
wrong_fix_catalogue.adjacent_api: n/a: the control task intentionally covers only the advisory's own route; the stacked task proves the adjacent conversion surface
